3624.title: Dynamic tool retention at the Claude compaction boundary
3624.rootCauseOneLine: Unresolved: the attached MCP server retains its tool across simulated compaction; live reconnect and Claude deferred indexing remain untested.
3624.proposedFix: Capture attachment tool names and real ToolSearch results in an isolated authenticated reconnect/compaction fixture before choosing a fix.
3624.caveats: Both runs mock the Claude SDK query and use real in-memory MCP. Neither reproduces the live catalog failure.
